Topic: Dirichlet-multinomial conjugacy
Story (story.md): Dirichlet is the multi-outcome Beta; multinomial is the multi-outcome binomial. Flat Dirichlet(1,...,1) prior plus counts c_i gives posterior Dirichlet(1+c_1,...,1+c_6), just like the Beta case.
Technical (chapter.md): Loop C Try: Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1,1) prior plus observed counts gives Dirichlet(1+c_1,...,1+c_6) posterior; plot marginal per face on shared axes at N=600.

Topic: Bayesian multiplicity is not zero — selection still bites
Story (story.md): Scanning many marginals and reporting the most extreme one is selection; Bayesian guarantees break under selection too. Hierarchical pooling is the right remedy and comes later.
Technical (chapter.md): Loop D Bayesian caveat: Dirichlet(1,...,1) is symmetric, not hierarchical; selecting the most extreme marginal reintroduces multiplicity. Proper fix is hierarchical pooling with a learned concentration parameter, picked up in later hierarchical chapters.
